name: Suspicious Login Response
description: Detect suspicious logins based on new location, new device, unusual time of day, or rate anomalies. Challenge with MFA or block the login attempt. All events are receipted.
purpose: Protect accounts from credential-stuffing, session-hijacking, and unauthorized access attempts with adaptive authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Detection signals defined: new location (geo-IP), new device (device fingerprint), unusual time (behavioral profile), rate (too many failures)
Risk scoring: each signal contributes to a risk score, configurable thresholds
Low risk: challenge with MFA step-up
Medium risk: block login, notify principal via alternative channel
High risk: block login, force password reset, notify all devices
All detection and response events receipted for audit
False positive handling: principal can confirm legitimate login, risk profile adjusts
Configurable per-account sensitivity: strict, normal, permissive
